description: This file defines a C# class called BufferWriterBox which implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface by wrapping another buffer writer instance, providing methods to advance, and get memory or span buffers.

classes.name: BufferWriterBox`1
classes.description: A generic class implementing IBufferWriter<byte> that wraps another buffer writer instance, providing a boxing mechanism for buffer writers.

methods.name: BufferWriterBox
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapped buffer writer instance.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property that returns a reference to the underlying buffer writer.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Forwards the call to advance the buffer writer by a specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> segment from the wrapped buffer writer.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> from the wrapped buffer writer.
